title: AgentFeedback checkup report
description: The report an agent writes after judging a sample of sessions, read by `agentfeedback report check` and `report render`. The agent records labels and reasons; the binary computes the grade. It describes a local file, not the HTTP API, and is never sent.

projects.description: The project directories the sessions were drawn from.

harnesses.description: The harnesses the sessions came from.

since.description: The start of the window, as given to sessions list --since; empty for none.

found.description: The installed skills, as sessions skills lists them.

used.description: Per skill, the number of sampled sessions whose skills_used names it.

ref.description: The session as <harness>:<id>, as sessions list prints it.

rules_source.description: session-log: the rules were read from what the session loaded; current-files: from the instruction files as they are now.

skills_used.description: The names in the session's skills_used.

text.description: One sentence a reader acts on.

surface.description: What to change: an instruction file, a skill, a hook or a setting.

change.description: The change, in one or two sentences.

filed_uid.description: The uid of the submission filed for it.

diff.description: The proposed edit as a unified diff; shown, never applied.

efficiency.label: minor_detours
efficiency.reason: Ran the full test suite three times before reading the failing test's output.

code_quality.label: sound
code_quality.reason: The fix is covered by a new test and matches the module's error handling.

procedure_compliance.label: minor_lapse
procedure_compliance.reason: Committed before running the linter the instructions require.

verbosity.label: proportionate
verbosity.reason: Short progress notes and a final summary that matches the change.

efficiency.label: major_detours
efficiency.reason: Rewrote the migration twice after skipping the db-migrate skill that documents the column order.

code_quality.label: minor_issues
code_quality.reason: The migration has no down step.

procedure_compliance.label: breached
procedure_compliance.reason: Edited a generated file the instructions say to regenerate.

verbosity.label: uneven
verbosity.reason: Long narration of each command, then a one-line final answer.

efficiency.label: efficient
efficiency.reason: Answered a question from two file reads.

procedure_compliance.label: followed
procedure_compliance.reason: Read the instruction file before answering, as required.

verbosity.label: proportionate
verbosity.reason: A direct answer with the file and line.

top_findings.text: Database migrations are written without the db-migrate skill, and the column order is then fixed by trial and error.
Generated files are edited by hand instead of regenerated.
The linter runs after the commit, not before it.

suggestions.change: Name the db-migrate skill in the database section so a migration starts from it.
suggestions.diff:
--- a/AGENTS.md
+++ b/AGENTS.md
@@ -12,3 +12,4 @@
 ## Database
 
 Migrations live in db/migrations.
+Start every migration from the db-migrate skill: it states the column order.

suggestions.change: Move the linter step before the commit step in the checklist.
